script.text: I could have beaten you if I had Rainbow Dragon in my deck!
According to the legend, the soul of the Rainbow Dragon lives inside an ancient stone tablet. But no one knows where to find it.
But when it is found, according to Pegasus, it’s going to be made into a Duel Monsters card.
Excellent! A fitting start for the new semester. Your first lesson is complete.
As I explained to you before, I fancy myself a man of action. You learn by practicing. So I'll be organizing mandatory duels every day and I suggest you comply.
Because from now on, I'll be monitoring your every move!
You’re my pupils now! And to succeed, you must duel! Mwahahaha!
Aww man. Something’s not right about this.
What gave that away? The maniacal laugh?
